description: Source code for managing outgoing OAuth connections in Mattermost, including API route initialization, permission checks, CRUD operations, validation, and connection handling.

classes.name: listOutgoingOAuthConnectionsQuery
classes.description: Represents query parameters for listing outgoing OAuth connections, including validation and default setting methods.

methods.name: InitOutgoingOAuthConnection
methods.description: Initializes API routes for outgoing OAuth connection management.

methods.name: checkOutgoingOAuthConnectionReadPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to read outgoing OAuth connections.

methods.name: checkOutgoingOAuthConnectionWritePermissions
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to write (manage) outgoing OAuth connections.

methods.name: ensureOutgoingOAuthConnectionInterface
methods.description: Ensures that outgoing OAuth connections are enabled and licensed, returning the interface if available.

methods.name: listOutgoingOAuthConnections
methods.description: Handles listing outgoing OAuth connections based on query parameters.

methods.name: getOutgoingOAuthConnection
methods.description: Retrieves a specific outgoing OAuth connection by ID.

methods.name: createOutgoingOAuthConnection
methods.description: Creates a new outgoing OAuth connection.

methods.name: updateOutgoingOAuthConnection
methods.description: Updates an existing outgoing OAuth connection.

methods.name: validateOutgoingOAuthConnectionCredentials
methods.description: Validates credentials of an outgoing OAuth connection by attempting to retrieve a token.
